remove_definitions(-D_WIN32_WINNT=0x502)
add_definitions(-D_WIN32_WINNT=0x601)

add_definitions(
    -D_WINE)

spec2def(msxml.dll msxml.spec)
add_typelib(msxml_tlb.idl)

# msxml.dll is C, and cargo compiles and links it:
# sdk/lib/rust/msxml-cargo (reactos-link, generated by tools/cargo_cell_gen.py).
# The C still compiled, in an OBJECT library whose compile the cargo link replays.
# How cmake compiled the target's sources, now on the OBJECT libraries.
# Generated inputs those compiles read, ordered before them.
add_library(msxml_shims OBJECT main.c)
target_link_libraries(msxml_shims PRIVATE wine libmsxml3 libmsvcrt libkernel32)
set_wine_module(msxml_shims)
add_dependencies(msxml_shims stdole2)
add_cargo_module(msxml msxml-cargo msxml.dll
    KIND win32dll
    DESTINATION reactos/system32
    EXTRA_DEPENDS msxml_shims psdk ${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/msxml_tlb.tlb)
